content: Yaka Yehoba i baek elana i ba, “Ya telewa nu ola Yabowaine kin matanaa, ge talim Eloni ni baaba kin elana ni ola wam palopita.
Baaba gegewena toto na baunaniwa nu baunanik Eloni elana, inoke ni ba kin elana Isileli ni talamwagil nihi tagilem wana panuwaa.
Yaa kin atena na pagasisi, inoke bwagana ginol yawiyawi ge abanuwaahi ona ni gewi na ginolil Itipita,
yaa anam nige ni hahago. Inoke nimwau na paelu lahi pupulowanina na ginol Itipita elana, yaka no gamagalau Isileli un gegewel na nulil tagilagil.
Sauga nimwau na paelu Itipita elana ge Isileli na nulil tagilagil wali panuwaa, yaka abwe Itipita nihi atena nau Yehoba.”
Yaka Mosese ge Eloni hi ginol ola Yehoba wana baaba.
Sauga toto hi na hi baaba kin elana, he Mosese wana baliman eiti ge Eloni wana baliman eiti tili.
Eloni wana Suki I Tabwa Mwata
Yaka Yehoba i baek Mosese ge Eloni elal i ba,
“Sauga ebo kin ni baewa eliyamiu ni ba, ‘Ginol yawiyawi etega nuku ginol inoke wami baaba ni patunahot,’ yaka nu baek Eloni elana wana suki ni ahe ni alilowana kin awonaa, inoke ni tabwa mwata.”
Yaka Mosese ge Eloni hi nok hi na kin elana ge hi ginol ola Yehoba wana baaba. Eloni wana suki i alilowana kin ge ana tolabe awoliyaa inoke i tabwa mwata.
Yaka kin wana tosiba ge wana tokukula i yogaagil, ge wali siba elana hi ginol i ola ya te toto Eloni i ginol.
Wali suki hi alilowan inoke hi tabwa mwata. Yaa Eloni wana suki heliya wali suki i tinonil.
Yaa kin atena i pagasisi inoke Mosese ge Eloni analiya nige i hahago, i ola valila Yehoba wana baaba.
Itipita I Logabola: Saliya
Inoke Yehoba i baek Mosese elana i ba, “Kin atena i gasisi nabi, gamagal nige i tatalamwagil hi eegon.
Sauga mweluluga ni lau i nana wewel Naile kaiwena, inoke nu na nu kite. Yaka suki toto i tabwa mwata nu noahe ge nu matamatan wewel labenaa.

Yaka nu ba kin elana nu ola, ‘Yehoba, ama Hibilu wama Yabowaine, i patunau ya baewa elam ya ba: No gamagal u talamwagil nihi egon, inoke nihi tapwalolo elau ula kekevana elana. Yaa nige anana u hahago.
Inoke Yehoba i ba ola hiwe, “Ginol etega na ginol inoke nu atena nau Yehoba.” He suki toto ya pihikan e, eliyana wewel Naile na lol inoke ni tabwa saliya.
Yaka moti nihi aliga ge wewel ni bweyan, inoke Itipita nige bosowailiya nihi im.’”
Yaka Yehoba i baek Mosese elana i ba, “U baek Eloni elana wana suki ni paelu Itipita wewelina gegewena elal, bolo hi sanisani, bolo dulein hi sani toulil
ge bolo opopwil, yaka nihi tabwa saliya. Panuwa gamwana gegewena ni sasaliya, i ola al patuna ge ulugomwa wewelina nihi saliya.”
Yaka Mosese ge Eloni hi ginol i ola Yehoba wana baaba. Eloni wana suki i latahin kin ge ana tolabe mataliyaa, inoke wewel Naile i lol yaka gegewena i tabwa saliya.
Wewel Naile moteliyau hi loaliga ge bwaleliya wewel i pabweyan, inoke Itipita nige bosowailiya wewel nihi im. Itipita gamwanaa gegewena i yousasaliya.
Yaa Itipita wali tokukula wali siba elana hi ginol i ola ya te toto Eloni i ginol. Yaka kin atena i pagasisi al inoke Mosese ge Eloni analiya nige i hahago, i ola valila Yehoba wana baaba.
Yaka kin ena i pek elal ge i sikal i na wana limiya, nige i nuwanuwatu bugul o kaiwena.
Itipita gegewel ali wewel imwim hi ken loyaloya wewel Naile bebenaa, kaiwena nige bosowailiya wewelina nihi im.
Pwagali
Yehoba wewel Naile i palogabola, enaa lan seben i mowasi ga.

footnotes.text: Itipita dulein hi ken inoke wewel i sani noem wewel bwabwatana elana i noek labi getoga.
